modules.module_title: Taking charge of shift from Circular loom operator (Shuttle type)

pcs.pc_description: come at least 10 - 15 minutes earlier to the work spot
Bring the necessary operational tools like J Hook, knife etc
Check for the availability of the weft & the condition of the same
Enquire with the previous shift operator for running parameters of fabric such as PPM, Mesh, Denier etc
Ensure the correct parameters are showing on the loom display
Check the condition of the running creels, for cross ends, ends pulling out particularly at the crease or side fold
Check the fabric for the running damages like end out, wrong winding, Side slippage, hole in fabric, weft catching, weft lashing in etc
Check for the size of the fabric roll & to see whether any indication is there in the cloth rolls
Check the cleanliness of the machines & other work areas
Check whether any spare/raw material/ tool / fabric/ any other material is under the machines or in the other work areas
Question the previous shift operator for any deviation

modules.module_title: Handing Over Shift to Circular loom operator (Shuttle type)

Report to his/ her shift superiors in case of absenteeism of incoming shift operator
Report to his/ her shift superior about the quality / production / safety issues/ any other issue faced in his/ her shift

modules.module_title: Ensure proper running of the loom

pcs.pc_description: Do patrol of the allotted looms
Check the signal lamp and identify the reason for loom stoppage
Attend the loom for warp breakage
Ensure the weavers/Spiral knot size is small with minimum tail end
Draw the mended warp tape using J hook through Heald wire, Reed ring as per the drawing order
Ensure the mended warp tape is passing through Creel Guide, Drop wire/ Tension rod, Maxi drug roller, Comb, Compensator, Heald wire, Reed ring
Replace with new Creel bobbin of the same denier for exhaust
Attend the loom for weft breakage
Ensure the weft tape is passing through shuttle guide, magnetic disc
Replace with new weft bobbin of the same denier for weft exhaust
Ensure the bobbin is fixed firmly inside the shuttle assembly
Bring the insertion finger to the front centre to see that there is no gap between the round ceramic & the fell of the fabric
Run the loom by pressing inching

modules.module_title: Creeling and drawing of Tapes in Circular loom

pcs.pc_description: Place the full bobbins in the creel stand
Place the colour bobbin in their respective peg for production of coloured fabric (Check/Stripe fabric)
Draw the tapes through their respective ceramic guides in creel stand and Drop wire/ Tension rod
Draw the tapes through the Intake comb through Maxidrag roller in creel zone
Draw the tapes through Water tray and sponge roller in creel zone
Draw the tapes through small comb via guide rollers creel zone
Draw the tapes through Eyelet bow and eyelet plate on loom
Draw the tapes through compensator
Draw the tapes through heald wire and reed ring based on type of weave like Plain, Leno, Antiskid, Ventilated, etc
Draw the tapes through the weave ring and tie up with the previously formed fabric at fabric spreader bracket
Run the loom by pressing inching
Ensure the formed fabric as per required specification
